stories.t: As e-bike battery fires mount, New York weighs tougher restrictions
stories.s: The deaths of 10 people in two recent New York ​fires prompted the New York City Council to hold ‌an emergency hearing on Friday on a raft of stricter rules for e-bike storage and battery safety.

stories.t: Sudurpaschim opt to field first against Lumbini in NPL final

stories.t: Road to the final: Powerplay could hold the key to NPL title
stories.s: Statistics from the third edition of the Nepal Premier League suggest that teams making the most of the first six overs have a much better chance of winning.

stories.t: Santoshi Shrestha wins two golds with course records in Maldives

stories.t: Saroj Kumar Yadav appointed Madhesh chief minister
stories.s: The JSP Nepal parliamentary party leader was appointed under Article 168(3) of the constitution after no coalition secured a claim to form the provincial government.

stories.t: Nepse loses ground as trading slows and investors favour select stocks

stories.t: Why Nepali cinema can’t stop playing ‘blame the buhari’

stories.t: No Indian minister to attend India-Nepal business roundtable during Shah’s state visit
stories.s: The absence of Indian ministerial representation at the November 22 roundtable comes as Prime Minister Balendra Shah seeks greater investment from Nepal’s southern neighbour during his state visit.

stories.t: Nepal has failed disaster survivors before. Can Bhotekoshi be different?

stories.t: Why a viral TikTok about ‘baddies’ has struck such a nerve in Nepal
stories.s: When a TikToker declared Nepal’s young women an ‘epidemic’, they answered with stethoscopes, spreadsheets and sarcasm.

stories.t: NPL final tickets sell out in seconds. Was it craze or embezzlement, fans question
stories.s: CAN and eSewa officials say the matter resulted from a large number of users accessing the app. They rule out black marketing.

stories.t: Lumbini and Sudurpaschim’s final clash will find the NPL’s ultimate team

stories.t: Victims of sexual violence during Maoist insurgency still await justice

stories.t: Nepal's investment reforms yet to restore business confidence

stories.t: India calls Shah’s visit ‘very important’, promises full state honours
stories.s: Kathmandu and New Delhi are still negotiating the key agenda items, possible deliverables and outcomes of the visit, as well as the contents of the joint communiqué and joint vision paper to be issued at its conclusion.

stories.t: Nepali rock gets its moment on the world stage

stories.t: Months after Bhotekoshi floods, families still await bodies and closure

stories.t: Shah and Lamichhane discuss the prime minister’s India visit

stories.t: Businesses call for policy stability and effective implementation to boost investment

stories.t: Nepal’s conflict victims still await justice 20 years after peace deal

stories.t: Myanmar calls ICJ ruling on genocide ‘unfair’

stories.t: Sirohiya calls for investor-friendly climate to revive economic growth

stories.t: Trump, Iran war and AI upheaval to shape global outlook in 2027

stories.t: Nepal begin Rising Stars campaign against formidable India A

stories.t: Salyan to reassess 756 earthquake-hit households

stories.t: Floral festoons ritual marks Haribodhini Ekadashi at Bagmati river
stories.s: The annual ritual at Pashupatinath involves stringing flowers across the river, a practice believed to invoke Lord Vishnu’s blessings and cleanse sins.

stories.t: Grand Theft Auto VI draws rave reviews as gamers enter Vice City
stories.s: Gamers worldwide flocked to the latest instalment of the blockbuster franchise, with launch parties, rave reviews and millions of downloads marking the release of the long-awaited game after a 13-year wait.

stories.s: The tunnelway carried 119,029 vehicles, generating revenue of Rs16.44 million, while its annual operating costs are estimated at Rs220 million.

stories.t: Nepal closer to having FIFA suspension lifted after NSC revokes domestic ban

stories.t: Three seasons, three finals—Sudurpaschim Royals do it again

stories.t: Can Bidya Bhandari change the fate of UML and the leftist movement?

stories.t: Old differences continue to weigh on Nepal-India ties

stories.s: Nepal’s air quality crisis demands urgent action as hazardous pollution levels pose severe health risks.
